name: proxymock-demo
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p /home/vscode/.speedscale /home/vscode/.local/bin && curl -sL "https://downloads.speedscale.com/proxymock/proxymock-linux-$(case $(uname -m) in x86_64) echo 'amd64';; arm | arm64 | aarch64) echo 'arm64';; esac)" -o /home/vscode/.speedscale/proxymock && chmod +x /home/vscode/.speedscale/proxymock && ln -sf /home/vscode/.speedscale/proxymock /home/vscode/.local/bin/proxymock
